findings.rationale: drs keygen previously printed the raw private key to stdout; it now writes the key to a 0600 file, refuses overwrite, and prints only public metadata plus the file path.

Policy-restricted invocation fields were optional during Go evaluation, allowing omitted args to skip fail-closed checks. VULN-FINDINGS.json also records a Rust counterpart that needs separate treatment.
MCP Shape 2 verification posted only the bundle and did not bind official tools/call params.arguments to the signed invocation args.
In-process MCP/A2A binding read request bodies without a cap before JCS comparison.
SERVER_IDENTITY default-off remains a supported single-server mode, but startup now emits an explicit warning when tool-server binding is disabled.
A nil nonce checker no longer silently disables replay protection; middleware fails closed with NONCE_REPLAY_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE.
Invocation freshness and clock-skew semantics must be configurable and aligned with nonce TTL before enforcement. Go and Rust verifier scope remains open pending that design.
